title: Rohit Jain Appointed Deputy Governor of Reserve Bank of India
summary: RBI Executive Director Rohit Jain appointed Deputy Governor for 3 years, replacing T Rabi Sankar upon completion of tenure.

blocks.content: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approved the appointment of **Rohit Jain** (RBI Executive Director) as Deputy Governor of RBI for 3 years starting May 3, 2026, succeeding T Rabi Sankar.
